reviews.text:
The woman who runs the place takes excellent care of the animals entrusted to her. She knows them well, and it's perfect.
Our pet came back very happy and healthy.
Looking for a place to board your pet? Leave them here, and they'll be safe for as long as you need them. Worth the trip, even if you're not in Montreal.
We left our cat Sky at this daycare for 2 weeks and to be honest, they took perfect care of him, I really recommend them!

We hired someone to take care of our cat while my mother was in the hospital. After she was discharged, we had to take the cat to the vet because he was unwell and had a lot of feces in his fur. We were referred to Garderie Poil aux Pattes for in-home care. Her kindness, excellent service, and patience with our cat Pacha are worth more than 5 stars. Thank you so much, Sylvie!
I highly recommend her in-home services.

We've been leaving our cat with Sylvie at Poil aux Pattes cat daycare for three years now, and we're delighted every time! You can immediately tell that Sylvie is extremely competent when it comes to animal care and behavior. The cats roam freely in the daycare, see people all day long, and have plenty of toys to play with. Plus, they get treated to pâté from time to time. We recommend it 100%, and the prices are very reasonable!
Thank you so much for your trust, Ghislain! Your review helps other owners discover our cage-free boarding facility for small dogs. We pride ourselves on providing a harmonious and safe environment.

Excellent service and a warm welcome :), always available even at the last minute! Our dog had allergies, and thanks to their recommendations, we were able to change our Boston Terrier's food. Since then, she's had no problems and has regained her healthy weight! Not to mention the significant monthly savings! Thank you!
Bon service.
Impeccable place! I recommend it 110%!
Excellent place to have your pets looked after!
THANKS

I went on vacation for a month, and when I came back, my cat weighed a kilo more than when we left him. Furthermore, my black cat, who is usually very sociable, was hiding all over the house, probably because of the constant barking of the dogs at the cattery. I absolutely do not recommend this place.

Hello Yannick Bureau
Thank you so much for your 5-star review. Our clients' satisfaction and the well-being of their furry friends are our top priorities. Thank you for choosing Garderie Poil aux Pattes for your dog's care!

Excellent dog boarding facility. Sylvie, the owner, came to our rescue at the last minute. We were going on a two-week trip, and the person who was supposed to look after our dog was hospitalized. We called Sylvie, and even though she didn't know our dog and we were leaving that very day, she agreed to take care of Ulysses. Our dog is very anxious and can be aggressive if he doesn't feel comfortable. Sylvie and her team took excellent care of him. He wasn't crated and had access to a sandy outdoor run. He also got to interact with other dogs. We highly recommend this boarding facility.
Excellent daycare! I recommend it :)
Great job !

Hello Mya,
Thank you so much for your 5-star review. Our clients' satisfaction and the well-being of their furry friends are our top priorities. Thank you for choosing Garderie Poil aux Pattes for your dog's care!

Wow! I adopted an Australian Shepherd in November. He was 4 months old. He's my first dog, an anxious one who bears the marks of a difficult start in life. But he's my love.

I paid for classes at the dog training school; I wanted to give him the best. It wasn't. The owner of the "Poil aux Pattes" daycare did more for us in three days of boarding (for a sprained knee) at a fraction of the price. Don't hesitate. I found the best for my little guy and wouldn't change places for anything. 😍

I've been taking my miniature poodle to this training center once a week for several months now. I've noticed a significant improvement in her behavior, especially her separation anxiety. She's much calmer when I leave the house. During …
This is my second time using this cat daycare for extended periods! Incredible and reliable service. Thank you to the whole team!
Kappa very happy there. Sylvie and staff treat the dogs very well
